news.title: Global Market: Yen speculators turn net long for first time since February
news.summary: Speculators turned bullish on the yen for the first time since February as expectations of faster Bank of Japan rate hikes intensified. Futures positioning swung sharply from net short to net long, reflecting renewed confidence after the currency recovered from a four-decade low.

news.title: Global Market: Samsung, SK Hynix reject $18.7 billion upfront power payment proposal
news.summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have rejected KEPCO’s proposal for a 25 trillion won upfront payment to fund electricity infrastructure for planned semiconductor clusters. The move highlights concerns over uncertain chip demand and the significant costs of expanding power infrastructure.

news.title: FIIs sell Indian shares worth Rs 14,475 crore in Sept; analyst warns soaring bond yields may deepen selloff

While its backlog and valuation metrics support the investment case, investors are watching whether heavy infrastructure spending can translate into durable revenue and returns.
